passages.provision_quote: A male, based on a student's biological sex at birth in accordance with the student's genetics and reproductive biology, may not participate on an athletic team or sport designated under this section as being a female, women's, or girls' athletic team or sport.
passages.note: Enrolled act's operative clause restricts girls' teams to biological sex at birth, matching rung 4.
Roll Call 402, veto override of HEA 1041; King recorded among the Yea votes.
passages.tally_quote: Yea 67 Participation in school sports. (2022) Nay 28 Excused 5 Not Voting 0

passages.note: King is listed as a co-author of the bill as filed.
passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. Chris Jeter, Rep. Joanna King, Rep. Robert Heaton.

rows.reasoning: Joanna King co-authored HB 1041 (2022) and voted Yea on Roll Call 402 to override the governor's veto, enacting HEA 1041's provision that 'A male, based on a student's biological sex at birth ... may not participate on an athletic team or sport designated under this section as being a female, women's, or girls' athletic team or sport,' which matches the rung requiring transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth.
